briefs.product_truth: A governed multimodal GTM employee that binds approved evidence, generation, review, activation preparation and learning without automatic external release.
briefs.audience: GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams at B2B AI software companies evaluating whether an autonomous GTM employee can be trusted.
briefs.problem: Strategy, content, approval and measurement live in separate tools, so teams cannot inspect how a brief became an asset or why the next action is justified.
briefs.desired_outcome: Move one rights-bound brief through a traceable operating record into review-ready GTM artifacts and an explicit human release decision.
briefs.offer: Inspect the end-to-end evidence pack, then decide whether to join the design-partner cohort.
briefs.voice: Lucid, restrained, provocative and operational; concrete nouns, inspectable proof and no generic AI superlatives.
briefs.approved_claim: Compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.

briefs.product_truth: A synthetic benchmark consumer app concept that turns one user-saved daily moment into a private weekly reflection card; sharing is optional and user-controlled.
briefs.audience: Busy mobile users who want to remember ordinary moments but abandon high-effort journaling routines.
briefs.problem: Most memory habits ask for too much effort in the moment, while automatic feeds turn personal reflection into performance for other people.
briefs.desired_outcome: Complete a private seven-day reflection ritual with a useful weekly artifact and no obligation to publish it.
briefs.offer: Try the private seven-day reflection challenge using the synthetic benchmark concept.
briefs.voice: Warm, observant, lightly surprising and specific; never sentimental by default and never manipulative about loss, streaks or sharing.
briefs.approved_claim: The benchmark concept turns one user-saved daily moment into a private weekly reflection card.

truth_boundary: The B2C brief is an explicit synthetic benchmark used to test generalization. It is not a shipped product or a performance claim.
